resources.string: Optional, saved per voice. Before starting, measure processing time and increase the block up to 0.50 s while preserving additional context. This may increase delay and preparation time. Your saved block is the minimum; the active block appears in the status. Turn off to use your exact block. Restart to recalibrate if device load changes.
Even a 0.50 s block has too little processing headroom. Reduce additional context or use a lighter model, then try again. Your saved settings were not changed.
